_dev_notes: GLOBAL LOOT ITEMS — can drop in any dungeon. Pool is filtered by min_level at runtime.
trash      : Junk with only a sell value. Feeds into a future merchant/sell system.
material   : Crafting ingredient for permanent relics (hub-world crafting, future feature).
consumable : Single-use item. effect{type, value} resolved by future ConsumableService.
card_pack  : Opens to offer the player X random card choices (rarity_filter restricts pool).
weight      : Relative drop weight. Higher = more common. Weighted random selection.
min_level   : Minimum dungeon level for this item to appear in the pool.
max_level   : Optional cap. Item removed from pool above this level.
sell_value  : Gold earned if sold at a future merchant (0 = not sellable).
DUNGEON-SPECIFIC items (local_loot) are defined inline in dungeons.json per dungeon.
ENEMY-SPECIFIC bonus drops are optional per-enemy fields in enemies.json.
bonus_drops: [{id, weight_bonus}] — adds weight_bonus to matching item in the merged pool.
RUN RELICS drop from dungeons too, but are defined in relics.json with relic_type='run'.
They are merged into the loot pool by DungeonService at generation time.

items.name: Tattered Cloth
